text: Has the actual system been proven through successful mission operations — that is, applied in its final form and under mission conditions?
helpText: DoD definition: “Actual system proven through successful mission operations.” Actual application of the technology in its final form and under mission conditions, such as those encountered in operational test and evaluation (OT&E).

text: Has the actual system been completed and qualified through test and demonstration, proven to work in its final form and under expected conditions?
helpText: DoD definition: “Actual system completed and qualified through test and demonstration.” Technology has been proven to work in its final form and under expected conditions. In almost all cases, this TRL represents the end of true system development.

text: Has a representative system/subsystem model or prototype been demonstrated in a relevant environment?
helpText: DoD definition: “System/subsystem model or prototype demonstration in a relevant environment.” Representative model or prototype system, which is well beyond that of TRL 5, is tested in a relevant environment. Represents a major step up in a technology's demonstrated readiness.

text: Has analytical and experimental proof of concept of the critical function or characteristic been achieved through analytical and laboratory studies?
helpText: DoD definition: “Analytical and experimental critical function and/or characteristic proof of concept.” Active R&D is initiated. This includes analytical studies and laboratory studies to physically validate the analytical predictions of separate elements of the technology.
